notes.title: RowRow has won Kongregate Monthly Contest!
notes.content: We submitted a Prototype Version of RowRow on kongregate last month. On behalf of the jolly users on the platform we won the [url=https://www.kongregate.com/contests]Monthly Contest[/url] for 2019 January and of course the feedbacks we got on the way helped us very much for the Steam Released version!
